headlines.title: Anthropic becomes one of world's most valuable public companies in stock market debut
headlines.summary: Anthropic is the first purely AI company to be publicly listed, creating a test for the entire industry.

headlines.title: Anthropic shares open 34% above IPO price in Nasdaq debut after record listing
headlines.summary: Anthropic shares opened at $111.50 in their Nasdaq debut on Thursday, 34% above their $83 IPO price, putting the Claude maker on track for a $2 trillion valuation (€1.8tn) after it raised $81.3 billion (€74bn) in the largest initial public offering in history.

headlines.summary: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

headlines.title: EU-UK summit — live updates
headlines.summary: The British PM is in Brussels to ink a host of post-Brexit agreements — and start talking about what comes next.

headlines.title: California targets Nvidia in China AI chip probe
headlines.summary: The probe by California, where the AI chipmaker has its global headquarters, follows former CEO Jensen Huang's departure.

headlines.title: EU must move beyond piecemeal trade deals with China, MEPs warn
headlines.summary: MEPs are calling on the European Commission to “ease” the regulatory burden on EU companies and deploy “horizontal” trade defence tools to tackle Chinese competition.

headlines.title: Iran balances ties with China and Russia as Trump ramps up pressure
headlines.summary: As Donald Trump seeks to tighten economic pressure on Iran, China remains its biggest oil customer and Russia a key partner. But both powers are balancing support for Tehran against broader interests with Washington.

headlines.title: How to watch the UK-EU summit like a pro
headlines.summary: After more than two years of talks, can London and Brussels finally agree on a reset? Here’s what to look out for as their leaders meet.

headlines.title: Tens of thousands of UK fridges secured from hackers in secret nationwide operation
headlines.summary: Supermarkets, warehouses, restaurants and stadiums have been scrambling to make their devices safe.

headlines.title: Can agritech investment turn Africa Into a global food supplier? {Business Africa}
headlines.summary: Can agritech and investment transform Africa into a global food supplier? West Africa launches a $650 million push to boost local production and African nations unite in Cotonou to strengthen defences against increasingly sophisticated cyberattacks.

headlines.title: Is the AI bubble bursting just as Anthropic goes public?
headlines.summary: The sharp sell-off in tech stocks after the US midterms and the Nvidia scandal has cast doubt on Anthropic s IPO. Yet with hundreds of billions still being invested, some think the AI party is still in full swing.

headlines.title: The web is held together by volunteers. AI could tear it apart.
headlines.summary: As AI reveals deeply hidden vulnerabilities, idealist coders and non-profits say they’re running on fumes trying to maintain the web's core vitals.

headlines.title: Airbnb's divisive new house rules come into force
headlines.summary: New rules on what Airbnb hosts can reasonably ask guests to do could mean fewer chores but higher costs for customers.

headlines.title: Portuguese families could spend 83% of average net income on rent, study finds
headlines.summary: Among 20 Portuguese cities studied by the property listings website Idealista, Faro was the least affordable for renters and Funchal for buyers. In Lisbon, advertised rents equalled 88% of the average net household income and estimated mortgage repayments 90%.

headlines.title: Nvidia forms national security committee after Huang affair
headlines.summary: Nvidia has created a board-level committee for national security and export control. This follows the resignation of CEO Jensen Huang over extramarital affairs, allegedly including one with a Chinese intelligence asset.

headlines.title: Zucman, le retour
headlines.summary: Un manifeste publié ce vendredi, un “sommet contre l’oligarchie internationale” samedi, une proposition de taxe supplémentaire : Gabriel Zucman est de retour au premier plan. Engagé dans une démarche de plus en plus politique, l’économiste français de 40 ans veut peser sur le débat de la présidentie

headlines.title: Fish and eggs al desko? The dos and don'ts of the lunch break
headlines.summary: What is acceptable to eat at your desk, without annoying your colleagues?

headlines.title: Commerzbank welcomes UniCredit commitments after Berlin agreement
headlines.summary: Commerzbank has welcomed UniCredit's commitments to keep the German lender listed and based in Frankfurt. This comes as Berlin and UniCredit have agreed on key terms of what would be one of Europe's biggest cross-border banking deals in years.

headlines.title: Could the Airbus €3 billion loan row reignite a US-EU trade dispute?
headlines.summary: The US says a record €3 billion financing package for Airbus may conflict with a transatlantic aircraft-subsidy truce. EU officials insist the funding complies with market-based rules.

headlines.title: After Putin talks, Trump tells Europe it could save lives and cash if Ukraine war ends
headlines.summary: The U.S. president followed up his meeting with Russian and Chinese leaders with a surprise call to Berlin.
